english.note: Use this for deceit as an abstract act or practice, especially in formal or official contexts.
Use this for the broader or more formal idea of deceptive cheating when financial scamming is not the main focus.

examples.english: The company will pursue the matter if there is any deceit in the contract.
examples.traditional: 合約入面如有任何欺詐行為，公司會追究到底。
